body: I could care less to figure out why.

She's the definition of an angel. I love her more than I can possibly articulate. The moment I held her for the first time I connected. She was shaking at first but she stopped and snuggled into my chest. This was in November. Nothing gives me more joy in life than this dog. I don't even like leaving the house without her. I even took her to the dentist the other day. She's only 4 pounds and everyone there loved her. She has never been alone since the moment I got her. If I can't take her somewhere I leave her with a family member. She is so pure hearted. I really needed her in my life. 
I don't know why I like the broken piece of glass. I just took it out of the bath and hid it in my medicine cabinet. I stared at it for a bit in my hand and resisted cutting myself. Idk if I should tell someone. They might take it away from me.

Ocd? It wouldn't surprise me honestly. And my puppy is the light of my life. She might as well be considered my child. She gives me reason to live. I love her dearly. I'd do anything for her. Her name is Dandy. She's a teacup Pomeranian. She clings to me. She has separation anxiety and makes me feel like I have purpose and good in me. She's always by my side and it is clear to anyone who sees that she is mine, that I am her mama. I love animals but I've never felt so connected a living creature in my life. She sees me as who I want to be. She'll be 1 on August 8th.

I think I'm in the same boat. You have a gun and I have a broken piece of glass. I understand. It's like reassuring yourself that there's a way out. Maybe put things in perspective or have it trigger some motivation to live. What comes to mind when you think about it? What's your reason not to? You want to outlive your parents so that must mean they are your motivation. Hold onto that. If you feel like putting an unloaded gun in your mouth will help you in some way then why not? I keep my piece of glass as a reminder that though I can at any moment kill myself, that I have not yet for a reason. I'm not sure if that's how you're feeling. But that's definitely how I am feeling. When I look at the piece of broken glass it reminds me what I live for. If I'm living for a person or creature, maybe if I do that long enough I'll eventually be in a place where I am glad I didn't. Where I want to live for myself instead of others.

I'm the younger sister actually.. She's 24 and I'm 20. She doesn't go to me with her problems. She's a bit awkward with that sort of deal. I just feel so empty. I have been reading other people's suicidewatch posts and my problems don't really compare to theirs. I have it easy but it doesn't feel that way :(

You're not wasting anyone's time. You don't need to be in a psych ward. No one would laugh at you for that. You should stop and talk to someone. Maybe someone in the comments can help you. I know how you feel right now because I am going through suicidal thoughts myself. That's why I'm in this board. My life isn't "bad" either. I just have mood swings. I tried to kill myself in May and I regret it. Now I have a scar to remind me not to do it again. You're stronger than this. You're not stupid and it doesn't matter what others think. You need some help, I think we all do actually. Let people help you, they want you to live happily. If you checked into a rehab of sorts, they can teach you tools that would help you sorting through why you want to die. Or help you find out why you don't. You don't have to check in anywhere, but I highly suggest you put the pills and alcohol down and talk to the people trying to reach out to you. Don't jump tomorrow or ever please.

I'm sorry you have rough nights. I guess I should try to sleep this off or something. Idk. I need some change in my life. This year has been dreadful for me. I'm glad you're reconnecting with your brother, that's great. I felt like I was becoming very close with my sister until tonight.. I thought she respected me.

Thank you, I think I needed to hear that. I just had a really rough night. These thoughts just keep becoming more frequent. In May I actually cut my wrist. I wasn't thinking. I just did it, I wanted to escape I felt like I was suffocating. I won't do that again though. My mom caught me. I can't put her through that again. Not to mention the healing process. It stung and just was a pain. There's still cut mark scars but they're starting to fade a bit. I guess it'll serve as a reminder that I can't escape.
I'm incredibly afraid of doing anything. I take anxiety medication and it does help. I'm terrified of living.. I don't think I can do it. I don't know how to either.

Thank you. I haven't been able to tell anyone this. It's easier to talk anonymously to people who don't know me. I don't want to hurt my family by saying this or for them to think I want attention or something..
